findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The baffles of the ice machine were observed with an accumulation of black mold buildup. PIC was made aware. PIC unplugged the ice machine and dumped the ice. The ice machine baffles were cleaned while inspector was present.  Ensure that food contact surfaces such as the baffles of the ice machine are monitored, cleaned, and sanitized on a regular basis.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The caulking sealing the counter top on the wall left of the dish machine was observed coming off. PIC was made aware. PIC assured inspector that the caulking will be done. Ensure that the caulking is fixed providing a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.
